messages:
maya-csm: Nimbus QBR next Wed. Onboarding cohort spiked embeddings overnight, can we do a 15m triage to add a short-term budget gate and a QBR slide? :wave:
owen-finops: Yep, saw the spike in billing feed. Tokens/day baseline ~2k -> ~52k for cohort. If sustained, extra monthly ~$6.8k. Recommend provisional daily cap + staged alerts. :money_with_wings:
liam-embed-ops: Two immediate levers: enable batching on batch-embed endpoint (low friction) and a feature-flagged soft daily cap. Longer-term: prefix-KV caching + adaptive batching. Batching could reduce unit cost ~20% for these payloads.
sarah-qa: If we add a soft-cap, I need the exact error contract to create tests. Proposal: 429 + JSON body {"code":"soft_throttle","allowed_remaining":N} + header X-Soft-Throttle: true. I'll write quick vectors for realtime and batch flows.
maya-csm: Proposed short plan: set provisional daily cap=60k, alerts at 50/80/95% notifying CSM+FinOps, soft-throttle at 90% with one-click override for enablement demos. I'll tell Nimbus and add to the QBR appendix.
own-finops: Draft alert config (engineer note): daily_cap=60000; thresholds_pct=[50,80,95]; soft_throttle_pct=90; notify=[maya-csm,owen-finops]; escalate_if>120%_for_2h -> pager. Can eng confirm feasible?
liam-embed-ops: Feasible. We'll gate throttle behind a feature flag and flip for Nimbus first. 429 will include allowed_remaining and ETA estimate when we can. Batching toggle can be enabled on tenant routing immediately.
costbot: Policy created: nimbus-embed-guard-3612345678. Notifications to #customer-success and owen-finops@redwood.internal.
nora-customer: Really appreciate the quick action. Please enable batching on the batch endpoint and we'll send top-10 prompts + expected concurrency. Also curious if you can add a short consumer-facing note about soft-throttle behavior for our engineers.
maya-csm: Good call. Liam + Sarah, please add a one-slide consumer contract + 5-point test checklist to the shared QBR doc (https://redwood.internal/qbrs/nimbus). Owen, drop a conservative spend table and a renewal-risk blurb (monitoring - medium due to spike). Plan to close before Friday so QBR has the mitigation slide. :thumbsup:
